Deterministic cross-check, which reproduces on 8 of the 9 VX rows the page carries from 2026-09 through 2027-05: the expiration is the Wednesday exactly 30 days before the following month's third-Friday SPX expiration (09-16 -> 10-16, 10-21 -> 11-20, 11-18 -> 12-18, 12-16 -> 2027-01-15, 01-20 -> 02-19, here 2027-02-17 -> 2027-03-19, 03-17 -> 04-16, 04-21 -> 05-21). notes: DISCOVERED during the japan-cpi-2027-02-19 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05), alongside opex-2027-02-19. VIX contracts AM-settle to a Special Opening Quotation (VRO) built from the opening auction of a SINGLE SPX/SPXW expiration exactly 30 days out — here the 2027-03-19 series, which is the March quarterly triple witching (opex-2027-03-19, estimate), NOT the 2027-02-19 monthly this settlement precedes. Two consequences. (1) The February VIX contract's own reference is the March witching, so the vol complex prices that corridor a month ahead of the equity calendar's arrival at it. (2) The front VIX future into the 2027-02-19 monthly expiration is therefore the March contract (VX/H7, expiry 2027-03-17 on the same fetched page), which AM-settles five hours before the 14:00 ET FOMC decision that day (fomc-2027-03-17, estimate) — the structure the vix-expiration-2027-03-17 ledger already owns and which is not re-litigated here. Impact LOW: it widens caution about the February corridor, supports one execution guard (nothing trades the 2027-02-17 opening auction), and licenses nothing. Unlike its March sibling this settlement does not land on a central-bank decision day; the nearest tracked decision is fomc-2027-01-27, three weeks earlier.
